in_marathi.name: Hrudvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे She who nourishes the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrudvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words hruda (heart) and vik (to nourish), Hrudvika refers to a woman who sustains and strengthens the emotional wellbeing of those around her. In Hindu mythology, Hrudvika is the name of a female demon who, despite her fearsome appearance, was known for her compassionate nature and her ability to provide solace to the troubled.
